suspended.title: Your Manar account is suspended
suspended.body: Manar's team suspended your account until {until} Dubai time. It ends by itself then.

banned.title: Your Manar account is banned
banned.body: Manar's team banned your account. It stays banned unless an appeal is accepted.

terms_violation.title: Terms violation
terms_violation.body: Using Manar in a way the terms of service do not allow.

abuse_or_attack.title: Abuse or attack
abuse_or_attack.body: Using Manar to harm Manar or other people, or to attack other systems.

fraud_or_payment.title: Fraud or payment
fraud_or_payment.body: A payment that was disputed, refused or not made by the card holder.

spam_or_bulk_signups.title: Spam or bulk sign-ups
spam_or_bulk_signups.body: Creating many accounts or workspaces in a short time, or sending bulk invitations.

security_risk.title: Security risk
security_risk.body: Your account looked taken over or at risk, so we paused it to protect you.

legal_request.title: Legal request
legal_request.body: A lawful request from an authority that Manar has to follow.

ban_evasion.title: Ban evasion
ban_evasion.body: A new account for someone whose account is banned.

other_policy.title: Other policy
other_policy.body: Another Manar policy. Write to support to learn more.

works.title: What still works
works.devices: Your computers keep working; they stop syncing with Manar while this lasts.
works.data: You can still download all your data.
works.companies: Company workspaces you belong to keep running, but you cannot sign in to them while this lasts.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.body: Tell us why this is a mistake. Someone on the Manar team who did not make this decision reads it within 3 business days.
appeal.once: You can send one appeal every 24 hours.
appeal.noCheck: The human check is not set up, so appeals cannot be sent from here. Write to support@fixio.ae.
appeal.error: Your appeal didn't go through. Try the check again, then send it.
appeal.limited: You can send your next appeal at {at}.

previous.UPHELD: Your last appeal was reviewed and the decision stands.

received.title: We got your appeal
received.body: Reference {code}. The decision shows on this page when it is made.
received.due: A decision is due by {due} Dubai time.

clear.title: Your account is active
clear.body: There is no restriction on your account.
